promptZh: 阅读短文，在空白处填入 1 个适当的单词或括号内单词的正确形式。

explanation.summaryZh: 短文介绍校园里的机器人图书管理员“小智”：它整理书架、回答问题，深受师生喜爱。
explanation.ruleZh: 注意并列谓语用 and 连接，enjoy doing 后接动名词，目的状语用 to do，将来时间配 will，非限制性定语从句用 which。

evidence.quote: it sends a message to the librarian's computer at once

segments.text: A robot librarian came to our school last month, and it has quickly become the most popular 'staff member' on campus. Students call it Xiaozhi. Every morning, before classes begin, the robot walks along the shelves
(put) in the right order. If a book is missing, it sends a message to the librarian's computer at once. The robot can also answer simple questions, and many students enjoy
(chat) with it while they wait. According to the head librarian, the machine was bought
(make) the library more friendly, not to replace workers, and it
(work) alongside them for years to come. Still, some younger students believe the robot is much
(clever) than any other machine in the school. Scientists predict that robots like Xiaozhi
(appear) in most school libraries in ten years. Our class once asked Xiaozhi
it could feel tired, and it replied that it needed rest only when its battery ran low,
made everyone laugh. Now, whenever we enter the library, we greet the robot first,
(smile) at it as if it were an old friend.

gaps.label: 第1空
gaps.explanationZh: walks 与 checks 是主语 the robot 的两个并列谓语，填 and。

gaps.label: 第2空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: books 与 put 之间是被动关系，描述经常性情况，填 are put（用 have been put 也可以）。

gaps.label: 第3空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: enjoy 后接动名词作宾语，填 chatting。

gaps.label: 第4空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 此处用动词不定式作目的状语，表示“为了让图书馆更友好”，填 to make。

gaps.label: 第5空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: for years to come 表示“在未来的许多年里”，用一般将来时 will work。

gaps.label: 第6空
gaps.clue: 用括号内形容词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 由 than 可知用比较级，clever 的比较级为 cleverer 或 more clever。

gaps.label: 第7空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: in ten years 表示将来时间，用 will appear。

gaps.label: 第8空
gaps.explanationZh: 宾语从句表示“是否”，填 whether 或 if。

gaps.label: 第9空
gaps.explanationZh: 非限制性定语从句指代前面整件事并在从句中作主语，填 which。

gaps.label: 第10空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 主语 we 与 smile 是主动关系，用现在分词作伴随状语，填 smiling。
